name: graphify-plugin
description: Turns a codebase into a queryable knowledge graph: scans code, docs and config files, extracts files, symbols, imports and doc references, and produces graph.json (9 query commands), an interactive graph.html and a markdown report under <target>/.graphify/.

description_i18n.en: Turns a codebase into a queryable knowledge graph: scans code, docs and config files, extracts files, symbols, imports and doc references, and produces graph.json (9 query commands), an interactive graph.html and a markdown report under <target>/.graphify/.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 将代码库转换为可查询的知识图谱：扫描代码、文档与配置文件，提取文件、符号、import 与文档引用，在 <target>/.graphify/ 下生成可查询的 graph.json（9 个查询命令）、自包含的交互式 graph.html 与 Markdown 报告。
